content.short: FusionX is a composable DEX purpose-built for the Mantle Network ecosystem, offering concentrated liquidity pools, token swaps, and yield farming.
content.description: FusionX Finance is a decentralized exchange designed for the Mantle ecosystem, offering both standard AMM pools and concentrated liquidity ranges to maximize capital efficiency for liquidity providers. The protocol prioritizes composability, enabling other DeFi protocols to build on top of its liquidity infrastructure as a foundational layer. FusionX provides competitive yields for liquidity providers across a growing range of Mantle-native and bridged token pairs.
content.meta: FusionX is a composable DEX built to support the Mantle Network ecosystem with efficient liquidity. Discover FusionX on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
